paper_title: Knapsack Cover Subject to a Matroid Constraint
statement: Our results do not rule out a FPTAS for the KCM problem. In fact, we are able to show FPTASes for the case of the KCM problem with a partition matroid. Is there a FPTAS for the KCM problem for arbitrary matroids?
context: Our solution to the KCM problem involves solving multiple LP’s. The knapsack cover (KC) problem has efficient greedy algorithms. Therefore, a natural question is whether the KCM problem has efficient greedy algorithms. Our results do not rule out a FPTAS for the KCM problem. In fact, we are able to show FPTASes for the case of the KCM problem with a partition matroid. Is there a FPTAS for the KCM problem for arbitrary matroids? Acknowledgements.
